title: A DAILY BACKUP OF YOUR SAVE
why: His answer 43 (2026-10-12): an automatic daily save backup. The first time the game saves each day, it first keeps a copy of your save as your last session left it. One copy a day, the last 7 days kept. Settings has a new row, Daily backups, with a button for each day: press it once and it asks, press it again and that day comes back, the same way a backup file restores (UNDO puts back the save it replaced, and the game reloads). The copies never cost your real save any space: if the browser ever runs short, they are dropped first.
now: The game keeps a copy of your save each day for 7 days; Settings, Daily backups, brings one back.
